subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 01, 2026
body:
**Rust 1.99.0 Released: A New Era for System Programming**

The Rust programming language has reached a new milestone with the release of version 1.99.0. This update brings significant improvements, including support for `extern "C"` blocks, which enable developers to interface with C code more seamlessly. This feature is a major step forward for system programming, allowing Rust to better integrate with existing C codebases and libraries.

**Community News**

The AcreetionOS community has been busy, with several updates and releases in the past week. Our community members have been actively contributing to the project, and we're grateful for their dedication and passion. We're excited to see the project grow and evolve with the help of our community.

**Practical Tip:**

Did you know that you can easily install AcreetionOS on a USB drive using our AcreetionMediaWriter tool? Simply download the tool from our website, follow the instructions, and you'll have a bootable AcreetionOS USB drive in no time. This is a great way to try out AcreetionOS without modifying your existing system.

Stay tuned for more updates from the AcreetionOS community, and thank you for being part of our journey towards a more free and open-source future!
